nodes.name: ERPNext Label Webhook
nodes.notes: Put this node's PRODUCTION URL in ilL-Shipping-Settings → Label Webhook URL. ERPNext posts a signed rate, buy or void request and waits up to 60 seconds for the answer.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: 'bad_signature', message: 'Invalid X-ilL-Signature' }) }}

nodes.name: Route Action
nodes.notes: Validate Request sets route to rate, buy, void or bad_request (with the error response already built).

nodes.name: Verify Address
nodes.notes: Credential: HTTP Basic Auth named EasyPost API, the EasyPost API key as user and a blank password (test key on staging).

nodes.name: Create Order
nodes.notes: Rates only; nothing is bought here. The Order id goes back to ERPNext as easypost_id.

nodes.name: Buy Order
nodes.notes: ERPNext sends back the service the rate step chose as service_selected (falling back to service).

nodes.name: Get Bought Order
nodes.notes: A retried buy reads the order it already bought instead of buying twice.

nodes.name: Refund Shipment
nodes.notes: Runs once per bought box. Errors continue to the regular output so Build Void Response sees every result.

nodes.name: Respond to ERPNext
nodes.notes: Every answer, success or error, is HTTP 200 with $json.response as the body (only a bad signature answers 401).
